We are seeking an experienced Senior Technician – Digital Delivery (BIM) with a strong background in CAD/BIM and infrastructure projects, particularly wet utilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and coordinating BIM models, overseeing 2D drawing production, performing model quality checks, and supporting the Production/BIM Manager in delivering projects in accordance with BIM standards, project requirements, and deadlines.
The role requires strong technical expertise in Civil 3D, Revit, Navisworks, and GIS platforms, along with the ability to guide technicians and coordinate multidisciplinary infrastructure projects.
q: Diploma in Civil Engineering or an equivalent qualification.
Additional training or certification in BIM and digital engineering will be an advantage.
Minimum 12–15 years of overall relevant experience, including at least 5 years of dedicated BIM experience.
Candidates should ideally have a background in CAD/BIM modelling and infrastructure project delivery.
Minimum 5 years of experience in infrastructure projects, particularly wet utilities, including:
Proven experience in BIM model authoring, coordination, clash detection, and drawing production.
Experience working on multidisciplinary infrastructure projects within an engineering consultancy environment.
Demonstrated ability to guide technicians, coordinate BIM deliverables, and support BIM/Production Managers.
Strong working knowledge of Autodesk Civil 3D and Revit for infrastructure modelling and drawing production.
Proficiency in Autodesk Navisworks for model coordination, clash detection, and visual walkthroughs.
Experience with GIS platforms and infrastructure data integration.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based collaboration and document management platforms, such as:
Understanding of BIM standards, BIM Execution Plans (BEP), and Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows.
Knowledge of industry data exchange standards, including IFC and COBie.
Strong understanding of BIM model auditing, QA/QC procedures, and multidisciplinary coordination.
Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across project teams.

d: The Truck Mixer Driver is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of a concrete mixer truck for the delivery of ready-mix concrete to customer sites. The role ensures that deliveries are completed in accordance with company procedures, manufacturer's recommendations, quality standards, and all applicable traffic and safety regulations.
q: Valid Heavy Vehicle Driving License (Special Use License preferred).
Minimum 2 years of experience operating heavy vehicles, preferably truck mixers or construction-related equipment.
Good knowledge of road safety regulations and defensive driving practices.
Ability to perform daily vehicle inspections and report mechanical issues.
Basic understanding of ready-mix concrete delivery operations.
Ability to communicate effectively with customers, site personnel, and colleagues.
Physically fit and capable of working in a demanding outdoor environment.
Safety-conscious with strong awareness of operating heavy vehicles around personnel and construction activities.
r: li
Operate the truck mixer in accordance with company procedures and manufacturer recommendations.
li
Deliver ready-mix concrete to designated customer sites as identified on delivery tickets and instructed by the Batcher or Production Supervisor.
li
Conduct daily vehicle inspections and ensure the truck mixer is maintained in accordance with company requirements.
li
Drive safely and responsibly while complying with all traffic laws and regulations.
li
Verify that adequate and safe access is available before entering and discharging concrete at customer sites.
li
Safely discharge concrete according to customer requirements and company procedures.
li
Liaise with customers, site representatives, and concrete pump operators to ensure efficient deliveries and excellent customer service.
li
Maintain the cleanliness and appearance of the truck mixer, ensuring it remains free from excessive concrete buildup.
li
Promptly report vehicle defects, mechanical faults, accidents, delays, or operational issues to the Batcher, Production Supervisor, and Workshop.
li
Report customer complaints regarding concrete quality or supply to senior production staff.
li
Complete delivery documentation accurately and maintain records as required.
li
Follow instructions provided by supervisors and other authorized personnel.
